name: RedCat Spookkasteel 1.0.8
description:
Version 1.0.8 makes the game much lighter on phones and tablets: on an emulated budget phone, Het Kerkhof went from about 15 to 34–39 frames per second. Existing player profiles, saves, recovery history and settings keep working without conversion or manual intervention.

## Phones and Tablets

These changes apply to mobile browsers and the Android app. Computers keep their current picture settings.

- **Lower automatic resolution:** **Automatisch** now stops at about 960×540, so the picture is softer than before. The new **Volle schermresolutie** option uses every screen pixel, and the other resolutions and the render scale still work.
- **Anti-aliasing starts off:** MSAA now starts at **Uit**. If your saved setting is 4x, it switches to **Uit** once, even if you chose 4x yourself. You can turn it back on in the settings, and your choice is then kept.
- **At most 60 frames per second:** Phones with a 90 or 120 Hz screen no longer draw the game up to twice as often, which saves battery and heat.
- **Slightly softer textures:** Surfaces seen at a sharp angle use lighter filtering.
- **Halos:** A glow behind an obstacle can react slightly later.
- **Colors:** A faster colour calculation stays within one color step of the exact one.

## All Devices

- **Faster lighting:** World lighting does far less work per pixel. In test frames on Het Kerkhof, the picture differs by at most one color step.
- **Less work per frame:** Collision checks create far less temporary data, and distant scenery, distant props and hidden halos no longer use time they don't need. Game decisions stay the same.
- **Pausing from fullscreen in a browser:** Leaving fullscreen during play now opens the pause menu. Browsers keep the first Escape press to themselves, so it used to only leave fullscreen.

## Website Hosting

- **One-command updates:** `tools/deploy-website.sh` refreshes the build, uploads only changed files and checks the live site. Nginx keeps running. See [docs/nginx-hosting.md](docs/nginx-hosting.md).
- **Sound file type:** The Nginx guide now serves the game's sounds as `audio/wav`.

## Measurements and Tests

- **Measured:** [docs/mobile-performance.md](docs/mobile-performance.md) has the numbers and `tools/mobile-performance.mjs` repeats them. They come from emulated phones with a software graphics processor, only on Het Kerkhof, so they don't predict a real phone's frame rate.
- **Tests:** All 1634 unit tests pass. Touch play, settings and screenshots were checked on Het Kerkhof.
- **Not run for this release:** The full set of 111 browser scenes last ran for 1.0.7. Other chapters, real phones and real Safari were not tested after these changes.

## Save Compatibility

- **Unchanged:** Storage origins, keys, player IDs, export format and recovery history stay the same.
- **New setting detail:** Settings gain one optional detail, which records the one-time MSAA switch. Older settings work without it.

## Release Scope

- **Updated the release version to 1.0.8:** These notes cover changes after the **1.0.7 release commit, `e935fe2f1`**.
- **Included desktop and Android packages:**
  - **Desktop:** Linux, Windows and macOS downloads cover x64 and ARM64.
  - **Android:** A signed direct-install APK and a Google Play AAB, with version name 1.0.8 and version code 10.
  - **Signing:** Windows packages remain unsigned. The macOS bundles built on Linux remain unsigned and not notarized. No Google Play upload or approval is implied.
- **Original decompilation:** The complete original decompilation archive, its checksum and its file manifest are attached, as with every release.
